population: External methodological checks, not observations added to the 7,300 Nordic works
pooling_forbidden: Sample counts concern different populations; never add them or estimate a combined proportion.

sources.title: Evaluating the efficacy and effectiveness of design methods: A systematic review and assessment framework
sources.scope: Design methods papers in six selected journals, 2020
sources.outcome: No included individual paper consistently documented all five evidence-chain links.
sources.interpretation: Critique of documented method evidence, not of all design fields.
sources.relevance: Use five independent M1-M5 coding dimensions.

sources.title: Evaluation of the relationship between studies of design research and design process in the field of architecture: a systematic review
sources.scope: Architectural and related design-research studies, peer-reviewed
sources.outcome: Four research-orientation clusters and five research-actor modes in selected studies.
sources.interpretation: Typology of inquiry, not measurement of replication frequency.
sources.relevance: Code time of inquiry (pre/during/post) and actor configuration.

sources.title: A Critical Assessment of Evidence-Based Design's Knowledge Base and Inspiration: A Systematic Review
sources.scope: Philosophy of evidence-based design and its analogy with evidence-based medicine
sources.outcome: Questions the general transfer of medicine's hierarchical best-evidence model to heterogeneous design inquiries.
sources.interpretation: Argues for epistemic pluralism rather than rejecting empirical evidence.
sources.relevance: Do not score an exploratory concept study as failed experiment.

sources.title: Toward replication study types for design science research
sources.scope: Design science research in information systems
sources.outcome: Proposes eight forms of replication and distinguishes utility-oriented design claims.
sources.interpretation: Domain-specific conceptual framework, not a counted replication dataset.
sources.relevance: Code replicate artifact utility separately from claims about truth.

sources.title: Replication studies in engineering design – a feasibility study
sources.scope: Engineering design case replication of a previous design-behaviour study
sources.outcome: Demonstrates practical adaptation and uncertainty in attempts to replicate design-research measures.
sources.interpretation: One replication case, not a fieldwide rate.
sources.relevance: Separate within-study significance from between-study effect differences.

sources.title: Considerations for planning, conducting, and disseminating research through design (RTD)
sources.scope: Research through design as scholarly inquiry
sources.outcome: Distinguishes RTD as an approach to inquiry rather than one fixed research method.
sources.interpretation: Methodological guidance, not an evidence synthesis with a denominator.
sources.relevance: Separate design acts, documentation and claims about scholarly contribution.

sources.title: The Design of Current Replication Studies: A Systematic Literature Review on the Variation of Study Characteristics
sources.scope: Replications in social and cognitive psychology, 2017–2022
sources.outcome: Replications often keep treatments and outcome definitions but vary or underreport population, time and setting.
sources.interpretation: External comparator on replication reporting, not directly comparable design research prevalence.
sources.relevance: Code treatment, outcome, analysis, recruitment, time, location, population and setting.

sources.title: Two decades of design research on lessons-learned systems: a systematic review and future research agenda
sources.scope: Information systems design of lessons-learned systems
sources.outcome: Synthesizes design features and identifies projectability and knowledge-transfer gaps.
sources.interpretation: Domain-specific information-systems design; no verified scope N used here.
sources.relevance: Code whether a published method transfers to another setting.
